```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Read CSV
games <- read.csv("footballthing.csv")
head(games)
str(games)


```

```{r}

# Number of games per team
table(games$Team)

# Win/Loss summary per team
games %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Games = n(),
    Wins = sum(Result),
    Losses = Total_Games - Wins,
    Win_Percentage = Wins / Total_Games
  )

# Summary statistics for opponent rank
games %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Opponent_Rank = mean(Opponent_Rank),
    Median_Opponent_Rank = median(Opponent_Rank),
    Min_Rank = min(Opponent_Rank),
    Max_Rank = max(Opponent_Rank)
  )

```

```{r}

ggplot(games, aes(x = Opponent_Rank, y = Result)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.05, aes(color = Team)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,1), labels = c("Loss","Win")) +
  labs(title = "Wins vs. Opponent Rank", x = "Opponent Rank", y = "Result")


```

```{r}

games %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  summarise(Win_Percentage = mean(Result)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Team, y = Win_Percentage, fill = Team)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Win Percentage by Team", y = "Win Percentage", x = "")


```

```{r}

games %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Opponent_Rank_Won = mean(Opponent_Rank[Result == 1]),
    Avg_Opponent_Rank_Lost = mean(Opponent_Rank[Result == 0])
  )


```

```{r}

# Logistic regression
model <- glm(Result ~ Opponent_Rank + Team, data = games, family = binomial)
summary(model)

# Predict probabilities
games$Predicted_Prob <- predict(model, type = "response")

# Plot predicted probabilities
ggplot(games, aes(x = Opponent_Rank, y = Predicted_Prob, color = Team)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  labs(title = "Predicted Probability of Winning vs Opponent Rank")


```

```{r}

# ============================================
# HOLISTIC TEAM COMPARISON ANALYSIS
# ============================================

# 1. Create comprehensive team metrics
team_metrics <- games %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  summarise(
    # Basic performance
    Total_Games = n(),
    Wins = sum(Result),
    Losses = Total_Games - Wins,
    Win_Percentage = Wins / Total_Games,
    
    # Opponent strength metrics
    Avg_Opponent_Rank = mean(Opponent_Rank),
    Median_Opponent_Rank = median(Opponent_Rank),
    Strength_of_Schedule = 1 / mean(Opponent_Rank), # Higher = tougher schedule
    
    # Performance vs quality opponents
    Wins_vs_Top50 = sum(Result == 1 & Opponent_Rank <= 50),
    Losses_vs_Top50 = sum(Result == 0 & Opponent_Rank <= 50),
    Win_Rate_Top50 = ifelse(sum(Opponent_Rank <= 50) > 0,
                            sum(Result == 1 & Opponent_Rank <= 50) / sum(Opponent_Rank <= 50),
                            NA),
    
    # Consistency metrics
    Biggest_Upset_Win = min(Opponent_Rank[Result == 1]), # Beat highest ranked team
    Worst_Loss = max(Opponent_Rank[Result == 0]), # Lost to lowest ranked team
    
    # Quality metrics
    Quality_Wins = sum(Result == 1 & Opponent_Rank <= 50),
    Bad_Losses = sum(Result == 0 & Opponent_Rank > 50)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Win_Percentage))

print(team_metrics)

# 2. Create a composite "Power Rating" 
team_power <- team_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    # Normalize metrics to 0-100 scale
    Win_Score = Win_Percentage * 100,
    SOS_Score = (Strength_of_Schedule / max(Strength_of_Schedule)) * 100,
    Quality_Win_Score = (Quality_Wins / max(Quality_Wins)) * 100,
    Top50_Score = ifelse(is.na(Win_Rate_Top50), 0, Win_Rate_Top50 * 100),
    
    # Penalties
    Bad_Loss_Penalty = Bad_Losses * 5,
    
    # Composite Power Rating (weighted average)
    Power_Rating = (
      Win_Score * 0.35 +           # 35% weight on overall wins
      SOS_Score * 0.25 +            # 25% weight on schedule strength
      Quality_Win_Score * 0.20 +    # 20% weight on quality wins
      Top50_Score * 0.20 -          # 20% weight on performance vs top 50
      Bad_Loss_Penalty              # Penalty for bad losses
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Power_Rating)) %>%
  select(Team, Win_Percentage, Power_Rating, Quality_Wins, Bad_Losses, 
         Avg_Opponent_Rank, Strength_of_Schedule)

print("POWER RATINGS:")
print(team_power)

# 3. Head-to-head comparison
head_to_head <- games %>%
  filter(Opponent %in% c("Miami", "Notre_Dame")) %>%
  select(Team, Opponent, Result) %>%
  mutate(H2H_Result = ifelse(Result == 1, "Won", "Lost"))

print("HEAD-TO-HEAD RESULTS:")
print(head_to_head)

# 4. Side-by-side visualization
library(gridExtra)

# Win percentage comparison
p1 <- ggplot(team_power, aes(x = reorder(Team, Win_Percentage), y = Win_Percentage, fill = Team)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Win Percentage", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal()

# Power rating comparison
p2 <- ggplot(team_power, aes(x = reorder(Team, Power_Rating), y = Power_Rating, fill = Team)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Overall Power Rating", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal()

# Strength of schedule
p3 <- ggplot(team_power, aes(x = Team, y = Avg_Opponent_Rank, fill = Team)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_reverse() +  # Lower rank = better
  labs(title = "Avg Opponent Rank (Lower = Harder)", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal()

# Quality wins vs bad losses
team_quality <- team_power %>%
  select(Team, Quality_Wins, Bad_Losses) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Quality_Wins, Bad_Losses), 
               names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Count")

p4 <- ggplot(team_quality, aes(x = Team, y = Count, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Quality Wins vs Bad Losses", x = "", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)

# 5. Final comparison summary
comparison_summary <- team_power %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
  select(Rank, Team, Win_Percentage, Power_Rating, Quality_Wins, 
         Bad_Losses, Avg_Opponent_Rank)

print("====================================")
print("FINAL TEAM COMPARISON SUMMARY")
print("====================================")
print(comparison_summary)

# 6. Detailed narrative comparison
cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("WHO IS BETTER?\n")
cat("====================================\n\n")

for(i in 1:nrow(team_power)) {
  team <- team_power$Team[i]
  metrics <- team_metrics %>% filter(Team == team)
  
  cat(sprintf("%s (#%d):\n", team, i))
  cat(sprintf("  - Record: %d-%d (%.1f%%)\n", 
              metrics$Wins, metrics$Losses, metrics$Win_Percentage * 100))
  cat(sprintf("  - Quality Wins (vs Top 50): %d\n", metrics$Quality_Wins))
  cat(sprintf("  - Bad Losses (vs 50+): %d\n", metrics$Bad_Losses))
  cat(sprintf("  - Avg Opponent Rank: %.1f\n", metrics$Avg_Opponent_Rank))
  cat(sprintf("  - Best Win: vs #%d\n", metrics$Biggest_Upset_Win))
  if(!is.na(metrics$Worst_Loss) && !is.infinite(metrics$Worst_Loss)) {
    cat(sprintf("  - Worst Loss: vs #%d\n", metrics$Worst_Loss))
  }
  cat(sprintf("  - Power Rating: %.2f\n\n", team_power$Power_Rating[i]))
}

```

```{r}

# ============================================
# HOLISTIC TEAM COMPARISON ANALYSIS
# (Miami, Notre Dame, Alabama)
# ============================================

# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)

# Read CSV (assuming you've updated it with Alabama data)
games <- read.csv("footballthing.csv")

# 1. Create comprehensive team metrics
team_metrics <- games %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  summarise(
    # Basic performance
    Total_Games = n(),
    Wins = sum(Result),
    Losses = Total_Games - Wins,
    Win_Percentage = Wins / Total_Games,
    
    # Opponent strength metrics
    Avg_Opponent_Rank = mean(Opponent_Rank),
    Median_Opponent_Rank = median(Opponent_Rank),
    Strength_of_Schedule = 1 / mean(Opponent_Rank), # Higher = tougher schedule
    
    # Performance vs quality opponents
    Wins_vs_Top50 = sum(Result == 1 & Opponent_Rank <= 50),
    Losses_vs_Top50 = sum(Result == 0 & Opponent_Rank <= 50),
    Games_vs_Top50 = sum(Opponent_Rank <= 50),
    Win_Rate_Top50 = ifelse(sum(Opponent_Rank <= 50) > 0,
                            sum(Result == 1 & Opponent_Rank <= 50) / sum(Opponent_Rank <= 50),
                            NA),
    
    # Elite opponent performance
    Wins_vs_Top25 = sum(Result == 1 & Opponent_Rank <= 25),
    Losses_vs_Top25 = sum(Result == 0 & Opponent_Rank <= 25),
    Games_vs_Top25 = sum(Opponent_Rank <= 25),
    
    # Consistency metrics
    Biggest_Upset_Win = min(Opponent_Rank[Result == 1]), # Beat highest ranked team
    Worst_Loss = ifelse(any(Result == 0), max(Opponent_Rank[Result == 0]), NA), # Lost to lowest ranked team
    
    # Quality metrics
    Quality_Wins = sum(Result == 1 & Opponent_Rank <= 50),
    Bad_Losses = sum(Result == 0 & Opponent_Rank > 50)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Win_Percentage))

cat("\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("COMPREHENSIVE TEAM METRICS\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
print(team_metrics)

# 2. Create a composite "Power Rating" 
team_power <- team_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    # Normalize metrics to 0-100 scale
    Win_Score = Win_Percentage * 100,
    SOS_Score = (Strength_of_Schedule / max(Strength_of_Schedule)) * 100,
    Quality_Win_Score = (Quality_Wins / max(Quality_Wins)) * 100,
    Top50_Score = ifelse(is.na(Win_Rate_Top50), 0, Win_Rate_Top50 * 100),
    
    # Bonus for elite wins
    Elite_Win_Bonus = Wins_vs_Top25 * 3,
    
    # Penalties
    Bad_Loss_Penalty = Bad_Losses * 8,
    Elite_Loss_Penalty = Losses_vs_Top25 * 2,
    
    # Composite Power Rating (weighted average)
    Power_Rating = (
      Win_Score * 0.30 +           # 30% weight on overall wins
      SOS_Score * 0.25 +            # 25% weight on schedule strength
      Quality_Win_Score * 0.20 +    # 20% weight on quality wins
      Top50_Score * 0.15 +          # 15% weight on performance vs top 50
      Elite_Win_Bonus * 0.10 -      # 10% bonus for elite wins
      Bad_Loss_Penalty -            # Penalty for bad losses
      Elite_Loss_Penalty            # Penalty for losses to elite teams
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Power_Rating)) %>%
  select(Team, Win_Percentage, Power_Rating, Quality_Wins, Wins_vs_Top25, Bad_Losses, 
         Avg_Opponent_Rank, Strength_of_Schedule)

cat("\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("POWER RATINGS (HOLISTIC RANKINGS)\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
print(team_power)

# 3. Head-to-head comparison matrix
h2h_games <- games %>%
  filter(Opponent %in% c("Miami", "Notre_Dame", "Alabama")) %>%
  select(Team, Opponent, Result) %>%
  mutate(Outcome = ifelse(Result == 1, "W", "L"))

cat("\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("HEAD-TO-HEAD RESULTS\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
print(h2h_games)

# 4. Side-by-side visualization
# Win percentage comparison
p1 <- ggplot(team_power, aes(x = reorder(Team, Win_Percentage), y = Win_Percentage, fill = Team)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Win_Percentage * 100)), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1.1)) +
  labs(title = "Win Percentage", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Power rating comparison
p2 <- ggplot(team_posssssssssssssssssssssssswer, aes(x = reorder(Team, Power_Rating), y = Power_Rating, fill = Team)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", Power_Rating)), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Overall Power Rating", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Strength of schedule
p3 <- ggplot(team_power, aes(x = reorder(Team, -Avg_Opponent_Rank), y = Avg_Opponent_Rank, fill = Team)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", Avg_Opponent_Rank)), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(100, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Avg Opponent Rank (Lower = Harder)", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Quality wins vs bad losses
team_quality <- team_power %>%
  select(Team, Quality_Wins, Bad_Losses) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Quality_Wins, Bad_Losses), 
               names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Count")

p4 <- ggplot(team_quality, aes(x = Team, y = Count, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Quality_Wins" = "#2ecc71", "Bad_Losses" = "#e74c3c"),
                    labels = c("Bad Losses", "Quality Wins")) +
  labs(title = "Quality Wins vs Bad Losses", x = "", y = "Count", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal()

grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)

# 5. Performance breakdown by opponent tier
opponent_tiers <- games %>%
  mutate(Tier = case_when(
    Opponent_Rank <= 25 ~ "Elite (1-25)",
    Opponent_Rank <= 50 ~ "Good (26-50)",
    Opponent_Rank <= 100 ~ "Average (51-100)",
    TRUE ~ "Weak (100+)"
  )) %>%
  group_by(Team, Tier) %>%
  summarise(
    Games = n(),
    Wins = sum(Result),
    Win_Rate = mean(Result),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Tier = factor(Tier, levels = c("Elite (1-25)", "Good (26-50)", 
                                         "Average (51-100)", "Weak (100+)")))

cat("\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("PERFORMANCE BY OPPONENT TIER\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
print(opponent_tiers)

# Visualization
p5 <- ggplot(opponent_tiers, aes(x = Tier, y = Win_Rate, fill = Team)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d-%d", Wins, Games - Wins)), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1.1)) +
  labs(title = "Win Rate by Opponent Tier", x = "Opponent Tier", 
       y = "Win Rate", fill = "Team") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p5)

# 6. Final comparison summary
comparison_summary <- team_power %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
  select(Rank, Team, Win_Percentage, Power_Rating, Quality_Wins, 
         Wins_vs_Top25, Bad_Losses, Avg_Opponent_Rank)

cat("\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("FINAL TEAM COMPARISON SUMMARY\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
print(comparison_summary)

# 7. Detailed narrative comparison
cat("\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("DETAILED TEAM ANALYSIS\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("\n")

for(i in 1:nrow(team_power)) {
  team <- team_power$Team[i]
  metrics <- team_metrics %>% filter(Team == team)
  
  cat(sprintf("#%d: %s\n", i, team))
  cat(sprintf("  Record: %d-%d (%.1f%% win rate)\n", 
              metrics$Wins, metrics$Losses, metrics$Win_Percentage * 100))
  cat(sprintf("  Power Rating: %.2f\n", team_power$Power_Rating[i]))
  cat(sprintf("  Strength of Schedule: %.4f (Avg Opp Rank: %.1f)\n", 
              metrics$Strength_of_Schedule, metrics$Avg_Opponent_Rank))
  cat(sprintf("  Quality Wins (Top 50): %d of %d games\n", 
              metrics$Wins_vs_Top50, metrics$Games_vs_Top50))
  cat(sprintf("  Elite Wins (Top 25): %d of %d games\n", 
              metrics$Wins_vs_Top25, metrics$Games_vs_Top25))
  cat(sprintf("  Bad Losses (50+): %d\n", metrics$Bad_Losses))
  cat(sprintf("  Best Win: vs #%d ranked opponent\n", metrics$Biggest_Upset_Win))
  if(!is.na(metrics$Worst_Loss)) {
    cat(sprintf("  Worst Loss: vs #%d ranked opponent\n", metrics$Worst_Loss))
  } else {
    cat("  Worst Loss: None (undefeated!)\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# 8. Statistical comparison
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("STATISTICAL VERDICT\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("\n")

winner <- team_power$Team[1]
winner_rating <- team_power$Power_Rating[1]

cat(sprintf("Based on holistic analysis, %s is the strongest team.\n\n", winner))

cat("Key factors:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(team_power)) {
  team <- team_power$Team[i]
  metrics <- team_metrics %>% filter(Team == team)
  
  strengths <- c()
  weaknesses <- c()
  
  if(metrics$Win_Percentage >= 0.833) strengths <- c(strengths, "excellent win rate")
  if(metrics$Strength_of_Schedule >= quantile(team_metrics$Strength_of_Schedule, 0.66)) 
    strengths <- c(strengths, "tough schedule")
  if(metrics$Wins_vs_Top25 >= 2) strengths <- c(strengths, "multiple elite wins")
  if(metrics$Bad_Losses == 0) strengths <- c(strengths, "no bad losses")
  
  if(metrics$Win_Percentage < 0.75) weaknesses <- c(weaknesses, "lower win rate")
  if(metrics$Bad_Losses > 0) weaknesses <- c(weaknesses, sprintf("%d bad loss(es)", metrics$Bad_Losses))
  if(metrics$Wins_vs_Top25 == 0) weaknesses <- c(weaknesses, "no elite wins")
  
  cat(sprintf("  %s: ", team))
  if(length(strengths) > 0) cat(paste(strengths, collapse = ", "))
  if(length(weaknesses) > 0) {
    if(length(strengths) > 0) cat("; but ")
    cat(paste(weaknesses, collapse = ", "))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

```
